extension.summary: Installs and updates the MediaHub skin
extension.description: Repository for the MediaHub streaming-style skin for movies and TV shows. Install the skin from Install from repository - MediaHub Repository - Look and feel - Skin, and it will be kept up to date automatically.

extension.summary: A streaming-app style skin for movies and TV shows
extension.description: MediaHub turns your Kodi movie and TV library into a modern streaming app: a rotating hero slider, network cards (Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, National Geographic, Star and 30+ more) that open a hub for that studio or network, and home rows you choose and reorder. Add titles to My List, rate them with thumbs up / down / love for better recommendations, and find more with More Like This, actor pages and a live search page. TV shows get a Disney+-style page with season tabs, Up Next picks up where you left off, and playback has a pause screen with the title's logo and a Skip Intro button. There's also a "Who's watching?" profile screen, a Kids mode with a PIN and six accent colours.
extension.disclaimer: The network card artwork is plain typography. Studio and network names are trademarks of their respective owners.

extension.summary: Up Next, My List, thumbs and recommendations for the MediaHub skin
extension.description: Runs in the background for the MediaHub skin. It works out Up Next (the next episode of every TV show you are part-way through, with the following episodes queued when you play one), keeps My List, stores your thumbs up / down as the library's own "my rating", and ranks Recommended For You and More Like This from them.
